# Agent platform

> The platform is two deployables: the **admin service** (`admin/`), a Prisma-backed
> control plane with a runtime API, an admin CRUD API and a server-rendered UI, and the
> **agent runtime** (`runtime/`), the container process that pulls its config from the
> admin service and turns Slack messages, chat messages and cron fires into `claude -p`
> sessions. This page is the overview and the data model; the detail lives in the docs
> linked below.

## Overview

The admin service owns the platform's Postgres database
(`DATABASE_URL_SHIPWRIGHT_ADMIN`, schema in `admin/prisma/schema/`). The platform
schema (`schema.prisma`) defines eighteen models: `Agent` and its `AgentEnv`,
`AgentCronJob`, `AgentTool`, `AgentToken`, `AgentPlugin` and `AgentMember` children;
`AgentCronRun` with its `AgentCronRunModelBreakdown` and `AgentCronRunSkillUsage`
children; `AgentChatTokenUsageDailyByModel` (daily chat-token rollups);
`AgentGitHubInstallationsSnapshot` (latest GitHub App installations per agent);
`PushSubscription`, `ChatThreadWatch` and `UserNotificationPrefs` (Web Push and
notification preferences); and `Account`, `AccountMember` and `AccountInvite`
(self-serve accounts). A separate file, `coding.prisma`, holds four models owned by a
coding extension; they share the same database but are not covered here.

Secrets at rest (env values, Slack and Anthropic keys) are AES-256-GCM encrypted at
the service layer (`crypto.ts`, `token-crypto.ts`); agent API tokens are stored only
as SHA-256 hashes.

How the pieces fit:

- [admin-service.md](admin-service.md): module map, boot order, data flows and
  configuration of the admin process.
- [agent-runtime.md](agent-runtime.md): the two runtime processes, boot order,
  Claude invocation, Slack, chat, cron, GitHub auth and health.
- [agent-types.md](agent-types.md): the Specialty manifests that seed a new agent.
- [shared-lib.md](shared-lib.md): modules shared by `admin/` and `runtime/`.

## Agent run modes

The only supported way to run the agent process is the container image. The Dockerfile
`ENTRYPOINT` is `bun run /app/runtime/entrypoint-main.ts`. It runs the startup
sequence (validate vars, fetch config, install plugins) and then spawns the repo-root
`index.ts`, which calls `startAgent()` in `runtime/boot.ts`. That process owns the
single health server on `SHIPWRIGHT_HEALTH_PORT` (default `3459`) for Kubernetes
liveness probes. See [agent-runtime.md](agent-runtime.md) for the sequence.

| Transport | When it is active | How you talk to the agent |
|---|---|---|
| Slack Socket Mode | `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` and `SLACK_APP_TOKEN` are present (from env or a config sync) | DMs, mentions and reactions in Slack |
| Chat poll loop | `SHIPWRIGHT_CHAT_SERVICE_URL` and the chat-service token are both set | The admin console's chat page (`/admin/chat`) |

Slack is optional: without credentials the agent runs chat-only and `health` stays
green, and Bolt starts as soon as a later config sync supplies the tokens. See
[agent-web-ui.md](agent-web-ui.md) for the browser-facing chat and PWA surfaces.

## Running locally

```bash
export DATABASE_URL_SHIPWRIGHT_ADMIN="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/shipwright_admin"

(cd admin && bun run db:migrate)  # prisma migrate deploy --schema=prisma/schema (idempotent)
bun run admin/src/main.ts         # from the repo root; also runs migrations at boot
```

The schema uses `provider = "postgresql"`, so `DATABASE_URL_SHIPWRIGHT_ADMIN` must be
a Postgres connection string. Never point it at a shared database. Run and test
details are in [admin-service.md](admin-service.md#run-and-test).

## HTTP surfaces

The admin process serves four groups of routes; see "Boot order" in
[admin-service.md](admin-service.md#boot-order) for mount order.

- **Runtime API** (`api.ts`), machine-polled. Mounted at `/agents/*`:
  `GET /agents/:id/config` and `GET /agents/:id/crons`. The runtime polls these about
  every 60 s. The config bundle returns decrypted `env`, `allowedTools`, installed
  `plugins` (split into marketplace and plugin), `repos`, the review and patch author
  allowlists, `restrictSlackToMembers` with the derived `memberEmails`, `trialExpiresAt`,
  `accountStatus` (the owning account's status, `null` when the agent has no account),
  `typeName`, the six agent-policy fields, and `phaseMethodology` when a coding
  extension supplies it. It responds `404` for an unknown agent. When Anthropic
  federation is on, Anthropic credential keys are stripped from `env` for managed agents.
  The runtime syncs `trialExpiresAt` and `accountStatus` into live refs
  (`agent-trial-expiry-ref.ts`, `agent-account-status-ref.ts`) that the Slack handlers
  read through `isTrialExpired()` and `isAccountPaused()` in `runtime/slack.ts`, so a
  suspended or trial-expired agent answers with a paused notice.
- **Admin CRUD API** (`agents-api.ts`), human-facing. Same `/agents/*` base path as the
  runtime API. Auth is an admin key, a per-agent bearer token or the `admin_session`
  cookie, checked in that order; see [agent-api.md](agent-api.md). Cron jobs and runs are
  in [agent-api-ops.md](agent-api-ops.md); tools, tokens, plugins, chat-token usage and
  the GitHub installations snapshot are in [agent-api-resources.md](agent-api-resources.md).
  Anything more detailed is in `admin/openapi.json`.
- **Accounts API** (`accounts-api.ts`) at `/accounts`; see [self-serve.md](self-serve.md).
- **Admin UI** (`admin-ui.ts`) at `/admin/*`, server-rendered, plus the PWA shell; see
  [agent-web-ui.md](agent-web-ui.md).

Token creation returns the raw token once; only its SHA-256 hash is persisted, so
validation is a single hash-index lookup.

## Data model

Sources: `admin/prisma/schema/schema.prisma`. Enum-like strings are validated in the
service layer, not by the database.

| Model | Owns | Notable fields |
|---|---|---|
| `Agent` | The runner identity | `name`, `slackId` (unique), `slackBotToken` / `anthropicApiKey` (encrypted), `selfHosted` (true skips Kubernetes provisioning), `repos` (`org/repo` strings), `restrictSlackToMembers` (default false; synced live with the resolved `memberEmails` through `agentSlackMembershipRef`), `typeName` (default `"coding"`; settable at creation, not via `PATCH`), `accountId` (nullable FK to `Account`, `onDelete: Restrict`), `trialExpiresAt` / `trialExpiryWarnedAt` (nullable; the first is settable via `PATCH /agents/:id`, the second is written by the warning sweeper), `ownerEmail`, `anthropicIdentityName` (unique), `anthropicServiceAccountId`, `anthropicFederationRuleId`, `k8sServiceAccountName` (all nullable, managed through `AgentAnthropicIdentityService`; a duplicate identity name surfaces as `ConflictError`). The columns `cleanupMergedWorktrees` (default true) and `cleanupAfterDays` (default 14) are runtime-owned policy fields, read via `GET /agents/:id/config` and synced into live refs (see [configuration-agent.md](configuration-agent.md)). `reviewAuthorAllowlist`, `patchAuthorAllowlist`, `autoPostReviews`, `allowSelfReview`, `minConfidence` and `maxFindings` are coding-owned columns that live on this row. |
| `AgentEnv` | Key/value env store | `key`, `value` (encrypted), `secret` (when true `GET /agents/:id/envs` masks the value); unique per `[agentId, key]`. |
| `AgentCronJob` | Scheduled prompts | `schedule` (cron expression), `prompt`, `channel` xor `user`, `silent`, `enabled`, `preCheck`, `name` / `system` (stable key for system crons), `lockdownDisabledAt` (set when trial-expiry lockdown, not the user, disabled the cron, so exactly those crons can be restored), `parentCronId` (nullable self-reference; a parent can have child "phase" crons, deleting the parent cascades to them). |
| `AgentCronRun` | Cron execution history | `cronId`, `agentId` (denormalized for queries), `startedAt`, `completedAt`, `skipped`, `skipReason`, `outcome`, `error`, `sessionId` (Claude session id), `lastHeartbeatAt` (latest debounced progress push, so the UI can show a "last checked in" signal for a run that stalls before `completedAt`), and `phaseId` (nullable, `SetNull` FK to the child cron that dispatched the run). `itemType`, `itemId` and `commandVariant` are nullable dispatch attributions written by an extension. Nullable telemetry reported by newer runtime builds: `baselineModel`, `baselineContextTokens`, `baselineInputTokens`, `baselineCacheCreationTokens`, `baselineCacheReadTokens` (first-turn context baseline), `turns`, `toolCalls`, `contextFingerprint` (sha256[:12] of the always-loaded workspace markdown and plugin version; groups runs by what the model was given), `pluginVersion`, `claudeCodeVersion`. When a `[silent]`-marker dispatch carries a `[skip-reason:text]` marker, that text becomes `skipReason`, otherwise `"command:no-work"` (see `runtime/markers.ts`). |
| `AgentCronRunModelBreakdown` | Per-model token and cost breakdown | Child of `AgentCronRun`; unique per `[cronRunId, model]`. `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, `cacheCreationTokens`, `costUsd`. Populated when one run spans several models. |
| `AgentCronRunSkillUsage` | Per-skill token attribution | Child of `AgentCronRun`; unique per `[cronRunId, kind, name]`. `kind` is `"skill"`, `"agent"` (subagent type) or `"root"` (turns before any skill was invoked). Attribution is last-wins: each turn after an invoke is charged to the most recently invoked skill or agent. `invokeContextDelta` is input plus cache-creation tokens of the first turn after the invoke. Written with the model breakdown via `PATCH /agents/:id/crons/:cronId/runs/:runId`. |
| `AgentChatTokenUsageDailyByModel` | Daily chat-token rollup | `agentId`, `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `model`, token counts (BigInt) and `costUsd`; unique per `[agentId, date, model]`. Accumulated atomically with `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE`. |
| `AgentGitHubInstallationsSnapshot` | Latest GitHub App installations | One row per agent (`agentId` unique): `reportedAt` and `installations` (JSON). A `PUT` replaces the whole list; no tokens are stored. See [github-multi-org.md](github-multi-org.md). |
| `AgentTool` | Allowed tool patterns | `pattern` (for example `Read`, `Bash`), `enabled`; unique per `[agentId, pattern]`. |
| `AgentToken` | Scoped API tokens | `token` (SHA-256 hash, unique), `label`, `revokedAt`. |
| `AgentPlugin` | Installed Claude Code plugins | `name` (canonical `plugin@marketplace` spec, or a bare plugin name that defaults to the `shipwright` marketplace), `version` (null means latest), `enabled`; unique per `[agentId, name]`. |
| `AgentMember` | Authorized human members | `agentId`, `email`; unique per `[agentId, email]`. Managed by `AgentMemberService`. Admins bypass this table. |
| `PushSubscription` | Browser Web Push subscription (RFC 8291) | `userEmail`, `endpoint` (unique), `p256dh`, `auth`, `detailOptIn` (`generic` / `title` / `preview`, default `generic`). User-scoped with no agent foreign key. |
| `ChatThreadWatch` | User watches a chat thread | `userEmail`, `threadId`, `agentId`; unique per `[userEmail, threadId]`. Upserted whenever a user sends a message from the admin console; targets the reply push, then `PushSubscription` supplies the device endpoints. |
| `UserNotificationPrefs` | Per-user notification preferences | `userEmail` (primary key), `autoFollowSessions` (default true), `reminderHourLocal` (0 to 23, default 9, validated in the service layer), `autoFollowSince` (nullable). |
| `Account` | Self-serve account owner | `name`, `status` (`active` / `suspended` / `trial_expired`, default `active`), `maxAgents` (default 0), `plan`, `trialExpiresAt` / `trialExpiryWarnedAt`. Owns agents via `Agent.accountId`. Managed by `AccountService`. |
| `AccountMember` | Account member | `accountId` (cascade), `email` (unique, lowercased: one account per email), `role` (`owner` / `member`). Created with the account for the owner. |
| `AccountInvite` | Pending invite | `accountId` (cascade), `email` (lowercased), `invitedBy`, `acceptedAt` (non-null once converted to a member); unique per `[accountId, email]`. |

All agent child models cascade-delete with their `Agent` (including `AgentCronRun`
via `AgentCronJob`, and the breakdown and skill-usage rows via `AgentCronRun`).
`AccountMember` and `AccountInvite` cascade-delete with their `Account`, but
`Agent.accountId` is `Restrict`, so an account with agents cannot be deleted.
`PushSubscription`, `ChatThreadWatch` and `UserNotificationPrefs` are not tied to
agents and do not cascade with agent deletion. Deleting an agent end to end goes
through `deleteAgentFully()`; see [admin-service.md](admin-service.md#provisioning-and-deletion).

## Testing

Unit, integration and smoke layers (`bun run test` at the repo root, which sets
`NODE_ENV=test`). Database integration tests run against a real Postgres database
(`DATABASE_URL_ADMIN_TEST`) and apply the schema with `prisma migrate deploy`, with no
Prisma mocking. Smoke tests drive the Hono apps through `app.request()`, except
`runtime/health.smoke.test.ts`, which boots the bare `Bun.serve()` health server
(`runtime/health.ts`, no Hono app factory) and calls it with real `fetch()`.
